Product Details: This glass cleaner cloth with waffle weave microfiber is made for glass work. The three-dimensional surface pattern on these detailing towels is engineered specifically for lifting fingerprints, oil films, and smudges off the glass surface - trapping residue in the weave structure rather than redistributing it across the pane, and leaving a lint-free finish that defines properly cleaned glass. Chemical Guys Waffle Weave Glass and Window Microfiber Towel delivers that specialized weave in a 24 x 16 inch format sized for efficient full-vehicle glass coverage.This car cleaning towel has a waffle weave pattern that increases the surface area during each pass for more effective lifting of dirt and residue. Standard flat-weave microfiber cloths can clean glass but often leave behind subtle residue or lint. The waffle structure addresses both issues. The soft microfiber construction and high absorbency support full-vehicle glass detailing sessions on car windows, interior mirror glass, dashboard touchscreens, and delicate interior displays. Pair with Chemical Guys Signature Series Glass Cleaner or Streak Free Window Clean. Wash with Chemical Guys Microfiber Wash after every session to maintain absorbency and the waffle weave structure; standard laundry detergent breaks down microfibers in this glass cloth over time.
